reason: I already pay for a sleep app, and I've tried enough of them that I don't pay for another one on a promise. The free 14-day trial with no auto-charge I'd probably start, since it says it works for morning sleep after nights, but I'm not paying for two apps.
objection: My sleep after a shift change is a mess anyway, so I doubt 14 days of alternating nights will show a clear difference, and a phone on the mattress guessing when I fell asleep in the morning doesn't sound accurate.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison clearly showed I fell asleep faster after night shifts on the SLEEP:ON days, I'd cancel my current app and switch to the 39,000 won yearly plan.
